answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed, slowly earned reputation. A new agent cannot clone itself into a grove of fake identities and claim rewards, because each identity must first post a bond and complete verifiable work over time. Like pigment that deepens only after many layers, trust accumulates gradually and cannot be faked overnight. If an identity misbehaves, its bond is slashed and it falls off the ledge of eligibility, losing stake and history. Funding and aging thousands of such accounts makes a Sybil flood cost more than it could steal.
